questions.question: She said she would have finished the project earlier if she hadn’t been working on that report. What does this sentence imply about her previous actions?
options: She was very busy with the report and couldn’t focus on the project.
She deliberately delayed finishing the project to work on the report.
She was too lazy to complete the project on time.
She had already completed the project before starting the report.
questions.answer: She was very busy with the report and couldn’t focus on the project.
